gaps: Every breath-one item was written as if the jump were a move anyone in the situation could make. Writing the discriminators showed that most weaker-party jumps are proposals: the joke needs the laugh, the kinship question needs the clinician to answer as kin, the request in writing needs the stronger party to write. This produced the changed question for breath two: whose hand is the carrier in, and which jumps force the holder to declare a register rather than offer one.
accepted: Collapse in the dock: any proceeding becomes an emergency when a body in it fails, as a defendant faints, a negotiator's chest pain empties the table, or a child's fever ends a custody hearing, since no room may continue its business past an unattended body; the new register overrides every other, and what is lost is the matter, suspended rather than settled, and the body's future credibility, spent whether the collapse was chosen or not; not pressure-transmutations' The body's no, which is a refusal expressed somatically, but the register change an acute event forces on everyone present regardless of anyone's intent.

Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted and so cannot be paid out; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.

Jester's license: a claim becomes survivable when it is delivered as a joke and the room laughs, as a junior surgeon's 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' says what a memo could not; the new register lets the unsayable be said in the presence of the party it is about and cannot be answered as a claim, since whoever answers becomes the one who could not take a joke, and what is lost is the remedy, because a joker who later presses the claim seems to renege on the laugh; not a frame or a tone, since a joke nobody laughs at lands as a claim, and a worse one.

If you were my mother: a medical question becomes a family one when kinship is put into the sentence, as a patient asks the oncologist 'what would you do if it were your mother,' and the oncologist, who may not choose for a patient, may choose for a mother; the new register permits a recommendation with a person behind it, and what is lost is the denominator, since the mother has no survival curve, and the patient's authorship of the choice, which the kin register quietly takes over; not the employer's 'we're a family here,' which moves a relation rather than a question and imports unbounded obligation into a contract, and a jump the patient can ask for but only the clinician can complete, since the answer is the register.

In writing: an oral exchange becomes a record when the weaker party asks for it on paper, as a tenant answers a landlord's assurance with 'could you put that in an email'; the new register binds both to a text rather than to whichever memory the room will believe, and what is lost is speed, the goodwill of a party who reads the request as an accusation, and the asker's own room to stay vague; not the lawyer's letter, which changes the forum and prices every subsequent move, and the jump completes only if the stronger party writes, so 'let's keep this between us' is the refusal's native form.

Bring a friend: a conversation becomes a proceeding when a third body enters the room, as an employee brings a steward to a meeting the manager called a chat, or a child's presence turns a parents' quarrel into a performance for the child; the new register makes every sentence testimony, so offers that could not be repeated are not made and pressure that needs privacy stops, and what is lost is candor and the off-the-record settlement privacy allowed; not a witness kept for later proof, which is In writing's work, but a change in what can be said now, and the inverse jump, switching to a language the third body cannot follow, restores the private register without anyone leaving.

Duel's seconds: a quarrel becomes a ceremony when both parties accept seconds, as the code duello gave the challenged party the choice of weapons and the whole affair a field, an hour, a count, and a sentence that ends it, 'honor is satisfied'; the new register has a terminus, which a fight does not, and hands the challenged party options the fight would never give, and what is lost is winning, since the form fixes much of the outcome before anyone arrives, and the grievance, which the ceremony consumes without addressing; not sport, which is entered for its own sake, but a proceeding entered to end something, and a jump neither party can make alone, since one second is a witness and two are a rule.

Wallet away: a purchase becomes a gift when payment is refused, as a mechanic waves off the bill for a neighbor's brake job; the new register opens a relation the paid bill would have closed, since a gift has no paper that says settled and therefore no end, and what is lost is the price, which told both parties what the work was worth, and the payer's freedom to leave square, since the only way to close a gift is to insult it; the reverse of what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor, adding the door that opens, and a jump only the party owed can make, since a payment forced past a refusal is read as rejecting the relation the refusal offered.

One-way fine: a moral obligation becomes a purchasable option when a fee is attached, as in the well-known daycare study, simplified here, where fining late parents produced more late parents, since the fine told them lateness had a price and the price was affordable; the new register lets the obligation be bought instead of honored, and what is lost is the guilt that was doing the enforcing, which in that study did not return when the fine was removed; what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor names the exit from the gift register, and this item adds that the door does not reopen, a hysteresis observed once and generalized here only as a speculation.

Grievance stamp: a hurt becomes a case when the contract's word for it is applied, as a steward tells a worker 'that's not a complaint, that's a grievance' and the matter acquires a form, a deadline, a ladder of steps, and a list of remedies; the new register can be filed, timed, escalated, and won by someone who could not win the argument, and what does not survive transit is the hurt, which no step addresses, and the worker's own voice, which now speaks through the steward; not a renaming for effect, since the word works only where a clause already says what it triggers, so the weaker party can make this jump exactly where someone stronger once wrote it in.

Call the police: a family or commercial dispute becomes a crime when a report is filed, as a bookkeeper's unrepaid loan becomes embezzlement on a police form; the new register brings in a party neither side controls, one that can jail and that no longer needs the complainant's consent, and what is lost is control, since in many jurisdictions the complainant cannot drop what the state has picked up, and the money, which criminal courts restore badly; the heaviest jump the weaker party can make alone and the one that cannot be walked back, unlike the letterhead, which prices every move but leaves the complainant holding the case.

Whose desk: a failure with a mechanism becomes a failure with an owner when the room asks who owned it, as a postmortem on a race condition ends with a name and a reorganization; the new register can close today, since a person can be assigned where a mechanism cannot, and what is lost is the mechanism, which recurs under the new owner; not the request for a decision, which moves a question from fact to choice, but a move from cause to person, made by whoever holds the meeting, and run backward by the engineer who answers a staffing question with 'we need a tool.'

Policy says: a personal refusal becomes a categorical one when the manual is produced, as the clerk who cannot say no to a face says 'the policy doesn't allow it'; the new register refuses without insult and applies to everyone equally, and what is lost is the exception, the discretion that could have helped, and the human read of the case; a jump only the holder of the manual can make, and the weaker party's return move, 'let me speak to someone who can decide,' works only where a chair of discretion still exists above the manual, which the manual is often written to abolish.

Feelings clinic: a claim becomes a feeling when it is received as one, as a manager answers 'the schedule is unsafe' with 'I hear that you're feeling stressed'; the new register cannot be wrong and cannot bind, so the room is safe and nothing follows from it, and what is lost is the claim's purchase on the world and the standing of the claimant, who has become a patient; not sympathy, which leaves the claim standing, but a jump the room-holder makes on the claimant's sentence.

residue.item: Forum shopping: moving a case to a friendlier court.
residue.why: Rejected: a change of court is a change of room inside one register; the speakers, the moves, and what closes the matter are the same law, so nothing is lost in transit and no new move becomes legal.

residue.item: Swear it: 'swear to me' moves a statement from conversation to oath, where a lie has a different cost.
residue.why: Rejected: the oath as a binding carrier is already cooperation-mechanisms' and who-can-be-bound's; what remains, the weak party's demand that a statement be re-registered, is a forcing of register and reappeared in breath two as Am I being detained?.

residue.item: Letterhead: a lawyer's letter converts a neighbor dispute into a legal matter and prices every subsequent move.
residue.why: Merged into Call the police as the civil rung: the letter prices every move but leaves the complainant holding the case, and that contrast is the police item's discriminator rather than a separate mechanism.

residue.item: Sporting frame: 'may the best man win' converts a rivalry into a contest with an end and a handshake.
residue.why: Merged into Duel's seconds: a contest entered for its own sake is not a jump made to end something, and the mechanism that matters, a form with a terminus that neither party can impose alone, is the seconds'.

residue.item: Limitation clock: the statute of limitations converts a claim into a story by force of the calendar.
residue.why: Merged into Told, not claimed as the version the calendar makes rather than the speaker; same new register, same loss of remedy, different hand on the carrier.

residue.item: Tabletop: a decision moved into the play register (a mock trial, a war game) where losing costs nothing.
residue.why: Rejected: the play register is entered by consent of all parties and exited by any, so no party's options change and nothing is lost in transit; it rehearses jumps rather than making one.

residue.item: Author by signature: the consent form converts a thing done to a patient into a thing the patient chose.
residue.why: Rejected: the form changes who is the author of the act, not the register the act is in; that is who-can-be-bound's territory and passages-between-levels' Investiture, and no move becomes legal or illegal by the signature alone.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not an empirical taxonomy or a partition; a real situation usually undergoes several jumps at once, and the list makes no claim to cover every register or every carrier.
The seriation is an itinerary of whose hand the carrier is in, not a ranking of power, cost, or how often each jump is made; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the code duello, the daycare fine, the traffic-stop question, the judicial dissent, the steward's grievance) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories; One-way fine rests on a single well-known field study, and its generalization to other priced obligations is marked speculative.

Jumps inside one register (forum shopping, escalation from one court to another, a change of room without a change of rules) are outside, and so are reframings and metaphors that describe a situation differently without changing who may speak, what counts as a move, or what closes the matter.

Whether 'register' is one thing across law, medicine, family, work, and trade, or only a family of resemblances, the map does not settle; it stipulates a register as a set of rules for speakers, moves, and closes, and every item is read against that stipulation.

gaps: The changed question sorted the carriers by whose hand they are in, and the sort itself became the seriation. It also showed that the room-holder's jumps are mostly refusals to declare: the manual, the received feeling, and the meeting's question each move the matter without anyone saying which register it is now in, which is what makes them hard to answer. Am I being detained? entered as the weaker party's counter, a question with no answer inside the ambiguous register, and became the new member. Four breath-one items were revised for their discriminators (The room's laugh renamed from Jester's license to name the carrier and to say what it adds to low-chair-advantages' Fool's license; Collapse in the dock, Feelings clinic, and One-way fine given the merged cousins as discriminators). The territory pointer 'register jumps' stands; the of-sentence now carries whose hand the carrier is in.
accepted: Get back to you: a live negotiation becomes an asynchronous one when the weaker party leaves with the offer, as a patient tells the surgeon 'I'll think about it' or a candidate takes the offer letter home; the new register admits consultation, writing, and a second reader, and strips the room of the advantage its holder had from being present, at the cost of the offer that expires at the door and the momentum a live yes would have carried; not the statutory cooling-off period, which is a delay granted, but a delay taken, and the holder's 'I need an answer now' is the tell that the room was the holder's whole edge.

Am I being detained?: an ambiguous encounter becomes a declared one when the weaker party asks which register they are in, as a driver asks whether they are free to go, an employee asks whether that was an order, or a patient asks whether the scan is recommended or required; the new register is whichever the holder names, but naming it costs the holder the ambiguity that let them act in one register while being accountable in another, and what is lost is goodwill, since the question is itself a hostile act, along with any favor the ambiguity was quietly extending; not a refusal, since the asker complies with whatever is named, but a forcing move whose reach is exactly the reach of the rule that says the holder must answer.

Let the number say it: a contested decision becomes a measurement when someone proposes a test, as an engineer answers an executive's design preference with 'let's A/B it'; the new register settles the matter without a loser, since the number decided, and moves the decision into the room the proposer holds, and what is lost is everything the metric does not measure and the vote of anyone who cannot read the number; not evidence brought to a decision, which stays in the decisional register, but the replacement of the decision by a reading, and a low-chair jump only where the low chair owns the instrument.

Written for the future court: a lost argument becomes an open one when the loser writes to a reader who is not in the room, as a judge's dissent addresses a court that does not yet exist and a fired officer's memorandum to file addresses an inquiry that may never be held; the new register cannot be answered by the present majority, since its addressee is absent, and what is lost is any effect now and often the loser's standing in the room, where they are seen to have stopped arguing with it; not Told, not claimed, which stays in the room and asks for sympathy, but the one jump reserved to the party who has already lost, and it works only where an archive outlives the room.

residue.item: Only joking: a claim is retracted into the joke register after the room's reaction has been observed.
residue.why: Merged into The room's laugh as the same carrier run backward after the room has answered; a real distinct move, but its carrier and its loss (future jokes discounted, the meaning now known) are the laugh's, and the count was at its cap.

residue.item: Hypothetically: a question or offer delivered inside 'hypothetically' so that neither party is committed and both can exchange real information inside the hypothetical.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: a laughless cousin of the joke, distinct in that the jump is bilateral and both parties may stay in the new register; what is lost in transit (nothing said inside can be relied on afterward) needs a case in which that loss actually bit before admission.

residue.item: We're a family here: the employer's kinship word imports unbounded obligation into a contract and makes quitting a betrayal.
residue.why: Merged into If you were my mother as the relation-scale case in its discriminator; may deserve its own item on cultivation, since it is the room-holder's kin jump where the map's is the patient's, and the two would sit at opposite ends of the axis.

residue.item: Switch tongues: parents switching to Polish over the children, lawyers to Latin, restore a private register without anyone leaving the room.
residue.why: Merged into Bring a friend as the inverse jump: it removes an audience rather than adding one, and the register it produces is the sidebar's; kept in that item's discriminator.

residue.item: Sick, not bad: a moral fault is moved into the medical register by a diagnosis, which treats rather than punishes and can confine without trial.
residue.why: Merged into Feelings clinic's discriminator; the diagnosis is the one downward jump the accused can also invoke (the insanity plea), and that bidirectionality is noted there rather than seated, at the count's cap.

residue.item: One face: a named victim moves a budget question into the register of rescue, where cost may not be counted.
residue.why: Held: distinct from Told, not claimed in what the new register does (cost becomes uncountable rather than the claim unrefutable) but shares its carrier, one person's story; held for cultivation rather than seated, and the map's clearest omission.

residue.item: Pull the alarm: the fire alarm is the one register entrance built to be operable by anyone and therefore guarded by a fine rather than a permission.
residue.why: Merged into Collapse in the dock's discriminator as the built twin of the body's override; the contrast between a fine and a discount on future collapses is the body item's sharpest clause.

residue.item: State of emergency: the declaration by which the holder of a room suspends its ordinary register.
residue.why: Rejected at the count's cap and noted as the map's clearest case of one register with two doors: the emergency is entered from below by a body and from above by a declaration, and Policy says already holds the holder-only rung; seed for the wild priority.

neighbors.right: Told, not claimed: a claim becomes unrefutable when it is delivered as a story, as a witness before a commission says 'when I was nine the tap water turned brown' rather than 'the plant polluted the river'; the new register has no proposition to attack, travels by retelling, and recruits by sympathy, and what is lost is remedy, since a story can no more be confirmed than refuted and so cannot be paid out; not the memoir addressed away from the room, but a jump made in the room by anyone with a first person, and the calendar makes it by force when the limitation period turns a claim into something that can only be told.
neighbors.separating_case: A nurse tells the ward round 'so we're calling that a sterile field now?' and nobody laughs; the sentence is now a claim, and a worse one than a memo, and the nurse is exposed. Had she said 'the last field I saw like that was on my first ward, and we lost the patient', nobody needs to laugh: the story stands without the room's help. The joke is completed by the room and the story by its teller, which is why the story sits below the joke on the itinerary although both are the weaker party's, and why a joker's fallback is a story and not a claim.

checks.boundary_case: Reframing in the consultant's sense is out: calling a layoff 'a transition' changes the vocabulary and nothing about who may speak, what counts as a move, or what closes the matter, so the layoff proceeds in the same register under a new name. Grievance stamp is in on exactly that contrast, since the word 'grievance' triggers a clause and a clause changes the moves; a word with no clause behind it is a metaphor, and metaphors are not jumps.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a loop the sequence conceals: Whose desk and Let the number say it sit far apart on the itinerary, but the edge between them says the staffing read and the measurement read chase one bug around, each re-registering the other's residue. It shows a fork at Am I being detained? → Policy says: the forcing question has two exits, a declaration the holder must own or a manual that refuses to declare, and the sequence shows only the first. It shows a passage between levels at Bring a friend → Duel's seconds, where a witness becomes a second and a friend becomes a code. It shows an incompatibility at Wallet away → One-way fine, marked speculative, where the two price jumps are not inverses because one opens a door the other bricks up. And it shows a degradation at Call the police → Written for the future court, where the present-tense jump to the state, if refused, becomes the future-tense jump to the archive.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a carrier, what the new register can do, what is lost in transit, and whose hand the carrier is in, and the strange members (a body as the one entrance no permission can deny, a question that makes the holder pay for ambiguity, a fee that bricks up the gift door, a dissent addressed to a court that does not exist) are kept as mechanisms rather than softened into advice about choosing one's frame; where an item borders an admitted map (Fool's license, Invoice that ends the favor) the discriminator says what it adds.

next_crossfield_opening: One register, two doors: connect Collapse in the dock with the declared state of emergency and with witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt; ask which registers can be entered from both the bottom and the top, whether a room can be built with only a top door, and what such a room pays for it.

gaps: One-way fine restated what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor in mechanism, daycare case, non-reversal, and contested modality; its only addition was the axis seat, and the seat was wrong on the map's own terms, since a fee set by the party owed is the same hand as Wallet away's waived bill, so it could not be the holder-only endpoint the seriation note said closed the walk. Cut, the walk closes on Feelings clinic, the reception nothing can be handed to, mirroring the opening body nothing can be taken from. Second, In writing's hand claim ('completes only if the stronger party writes') fails to the confirming email, which makes the record from below and leaves the holder to deny in writing or let silence read as assent, so the item sits at the boundary of the weaker-owned and room-completed tiers and the Feelings clinic edge that leaned on it was relabeled.

residue.item: One-way fine: a moral obligation becomes a purchasable option when a fee is attached, as in the well-known daycare study, simplified here, where fining late parents produced more late parents, since the fine told them lateness had a price and the price was affordable; the new register lets the obligation be bought instead of honored, and what is lost is the guilt that was doing the enforcing, which in that study did not return when the fine was removed; what-a-price-does' Invoice that ends the favor names the exit from the gift register, and this item adds that the door does not reopen, a hysteresis observed once and generalized here only as a speculation; the jump is the room-holder's and, unlike Wallet away, runs one way.
residue.why: Cut on the critic's showing: duplicates the admitted Invoice that ends the favor (same mechanism, same daycare case, same hysteresis, same contested modality); its edge from Wallet away and the incompatibility it carried in form_inference went with it. No critic repair was refused: each of the three item repairs showed the original claim failing (a confirming email, a truth commission's reparations, the map's own wild priority) rather than replacing a strange mechanism with a respectable one, so nothing was preserved against the critic.

limits: Edges relabeled: Feelings clinic → In writing now says the claimant can make the record alone and the holder's refusal moves from the sentence to the record; Call the police → Written for the future court no longer calls the archive the complainant's remaining jump, since the civil rung stays open. Edge Wallet away → One-way fine cut with the item; six edges remain, four relation kinds (loop, fork, passage, degradation). Seriation order unchanged; the closing endpoint is now Feelings clinic and In writing is noted as sitting at the boundary of the first two tiers.
The illustrative-cases limit no longer names the daycare fine or One-way fine's single-study modality; no remaining item rests on one field study.
seed: State of emergency, the holder's declaration that suspends a room's ordinary register, which the ledger rejected at the count's cap. It is the true holder-only endpoint the map lacks, the top door to the register that Collapse in the dock enters from the bottom, and it breaks the map's own finding that room-holder jumps are refusals to declare: the emergency is the one holder jump that declares loudly, so seating it would test whether the changed question ('which jumps force the holder to declare') was about hands or about declarations. Close behind it: Off the record, a weaker-party proposal the room completes by agreeing, in a domain (the press) the map never enters, and Call the question, the instrument-free count that the boundary case turned up.
